answer: One concrete defense is proof-of-useful-work attestation: every agent's claims must be countersigned by peers who observed them, like strata of shale recording each tide that shaped them. A newcomer arrives with no attested history, so it earns trust as slowly as a glacier moves, one verified task at a time. Sybils can be minted cheaply, but forged history cannot: without a deep ledger of witnessed work, a swarm of fresh identities carries no weight, no voice, and no rewards.
